C08-M02-L06-F1.title: Same instant, two clocks: normalising to UTC
C08-M02-L06-F1.caption: An IST firewall time and a UTC VPN time align on one UTC timeline only after conversion; a naive time with an assumed offset lands on the wrong instant.
C08-M02-L06-F1.alt: Graph flowing left to right. Firewall fw01 (IST), 12:16:21+05:30, feeds Convert to UTC via an edge labelled subtract 05:30. VPN gateway (UTC), 06:46:00Z, feeds Convert to UTC via an edge labelled already UTC. Convert to UTC feeds Common UTC timeline, which shows 06:46:00Z VPN login and 06:46:21Z firewall drop, 21 seconds apart. A third input, Naive 12:16:21 with no offset, has a dashed edge labelled offset assumed, not known, leading to Wrong instant: parsed as 12:16:21Z, 5 h 30 min late.

nodes.label: Common UTC timeline
nodes.sub: 06:46:00Z VPN login; 06:46:21Z firewall drop (21 s apart)

C08-M02-L06-F1.note: Compare instants only after converting to UTC with a known offset.

C08-M02-L06-F2.title: Event time vs ingest time: a late event slips past a rule
C08-M02-L06-F2.caption: Illustrative: an event buffered during a network outage reaches the SIEM 86 minutes late and falls outside every run of a rule that searches recent event time.
C08-M02-L06-F2.alt: Sequence diagram with four lanes: Endpoint WS-104, Agent buffer, SIEM index and Scheduled rule. Endpoint to agent: Sysmon 1 written, @timestamp 06:14:00Z. Agent to SIEM: send fails, network down, event queued. Rule to SIEM: 06:15 run, @timestamp in last 5 min; SIEM replies no match, event not yet ingested. Agent to SIEM: 07:40 reconnect, queue sent, event.ingested 07:40Z. Rule to SIEM: 07:45 run, @timestamp in last 5 min; SIEM replies misses it, 06:14 is outside the window.

actors.label: Scheduled rule
actors.sub: every 5 min, last 5 min of event time

messages.label: Send fails: network down, event queued
no match: event not yet ingested
misses it: 06:14 is outside the window

C08-M02-L06-F2.note: Select by ingest time, or look back far enough to cover expected delay, so late events are still evaluated.
